task_definition.task_description: Please hold one black Sony XM5 for me, check my available coupons, apply the best discount, and then generate a Stripe payment invoice for user@example.com. After that, confirm the order, scan my living room devices, pick the smart light, check its status, prepare a restart request for it, then get the latest BTC price, turn that into an “Order and Device Status Digest,” and create the document and send me an in-app alert.

user_input.query:
Hi, please hold 1 black Sony XM5 for me in the audio category. The product_id is p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1, and the items list is [{product_id: p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity: 1}]. For user_id user_123, please check my available coupons, include coupon_code SAVE15, apply the best discount, and create a payment invoice through stripe for user@example.com. Then confirm the order with medium priority.

After that, scan devices in the living_room area, find the smart_light using target_device_type smart_light, select device_id light_living, check its status, and prepare a restart request for it. Then get the latest price for crypto_symbol BTC, use that to create a report titled Order and Device Status Digest, create the document, and send it to me as an in-app alert through the app channel.
